Her hair is styled in loose waves, and she appears to be mid-stride, with one foot lifted as she moves forward. In the background, several other pedestrians can be seen walking along the sidewalk. One person is wearing a patterned shirt and jeans, while another is dressed in a light-colored top and dark pants.
